experiment: O2-control GRPO at 1800 steps (no filter — the single-delta companion to o2f1800)
filter_contribution_verdict: The prescreen filter is NOT needed at 1800 steps: control 258 >= filtered 255, both decisively above bank 242. The filter helped early training (2x partial-solved at 300 steps) but the 6x budget subsumes it. SCALED RL IS THE DRIVER: GRPO@1800 on the b4 anchor delivers +5.2 to +6.8pp exact at p<=0.0024 with flat restraint, with or without the filter.
